name: Candlelight: The Best of Hans Zimmer
description: A string quartet plays Hans Zimmer film scores by candlelight at the Hilton Porto Gaia on Saturday 2 January at 19:00. Tickets from €13.20.
longDescription:
Candlelight is Fever's series of short concerts played in rooms lit by hundreds of candles. This one is a tribute to Hans Zimmer, played by a string quartet. It has no link to the composer or his representatives.

The planned programme includes Time from Inception, This Land from The Lion King, Cornfield Chase from Interstellar, the Gladiator and Dune suites, music from The Dark Knight, Dunkirk and Wonder Woman, and it ends with He's a Pirate from Pirates of the Caribbean. The concert lasts 60 minutes. It's open to ages 8 and up, and under-16s must come with an adult.

It's on Saturday 2 January 2027 at 19:00 at the Hilton Porto Gaia in Vila Nova de Gaia. Doors open 30 minutes before, and nobody gets in once they close. Seats are given out on arrival in order of arrival, within your ticket type, so it pays to come early. The venue is wheelchair accessible. Tickets from €13.20.
